continuation.comparison_scope: Previous future schedule versus a new schedule with identical boundary inventories/cohorts and reviewed future inputs; elapsed days frozen.
continuation.resource_scope: Finite usable stores only when configured; daily flow capacity is not a reservoir. No water recycling, energy regeneration or implicit resupply is modeled.
continuation.crew_target_scope: Summed reviewed targets constrain crew totals; individual meal allocation and iron treatment are not modeled.

planning_advice.weight_basis: Shares of future shortfall divided by each day's crew target.
planning_advice.scoring_basis: With a complete saved forecast and selected nutrient gaps, score credits only the consumable extra harvest against that harvest day's remaining gaps, divided by that day's crew nutrient targets. Earlier or later gaps receive no credit. Otherwise score compares normalized nutrient production per m²/growth day. Production score breaks timing ties; no nutrient quantities with different units are added directly.
